nature: EXPLORATORY post-hoc comparison planned after the 8,000-fit and 600-fit C_Q results were seen; no MCEM; same saved fits for both criteria
lineage: E scalar (DualExpFamLSMConsistent, numerics_mode=consistent); not adopted for manuscript (Human Gate)

sources.main10: main run, iteration-10 states, series O/A/B (6,000)

excluded: series C (Gaussian Y): outside the verified Laplace evaluator

criterion.C_Lap: C_Lap(K) = -2 ln p_Lap + d_K ln N; ln p_Lap = Phi(Z_hat) + (nK/2) ln 2pi - 1/2 ln|H|; Z_hat = joint mode of Phi from Z0; H = -grad^2 Phi(Z_hat)
criterion.d_K: K d - K(K-1)/2 (loading count; Gaussian-X dispersions, w0, w are K-invariant and not added; K-differences equal those of p_K)
criterion.C_Q: copied from the recorded runs (main per_fit C_Q; conv checkpoint_scores checkpoint 40); never recomputed or replaced

selection_rule.primary: per (source, dataset): argmin_K of the unweighted mean over the two inits of the criterion; ties within 1e-9 -> smallest K; identical rule for C_Q and C_Lap
selection_rule.per_init: argmin_K within one init; only if that init's 10 evaluations are OK

failure_rule.per_evaluation: recorded once; never retried; no alternative start (Z_mean, random, other checkpoint); no ridge/jitter; no tolerance or max_iter change; no candidate K dropped
failure_rule.dataset: if any of the 20 C_Lap evaluations of a (source, dataset) is not OK, its C_Lap selection is INCOMPLETE; denominator stays 10; INCOMPLETE is reported next to the counts; C_Q selection is reported for every dataset
stop: C_Q selection differs from the recorded pre-specified analyses

execution.unit_of_work: one (source, dataset) = 20 evaluations; rows appended only when the whole job finished
execution.resume_rule: a (source, dataset) job is done iff its 20 rows are in evaluations.csv; done jobs are never re-run; worker count does not change any number (each evaluation is deterministic)
execution.memory_rule: before dispatching each job, if available memory < 1500 MB on 2 consecutive checks, stop dispatching, finish running jobs, record STOPPED_MEMORY (resumable)

analysis_plan.primary_question: A-b-9 (main10 and conv40): on the same theta_hat, in how many of the 10 datasets does the C_Lap selection differ from C_Q, and how many select K_TRUE (exact count, Clopper-Pearson CI)
analysis_plan.control: O-b-9 (C_Q 10/10): does C_Lap keep 10/10; regime a: C_Lap over-selection
checks: K_TRUE=3 regime a vs b: C_Lap rows identical (design-identical)
interpretation_rules: differences between C_Q and C_Lap are attributed to the criterion only jointly: evaluation point (E-step MC samples vs joint mode), prior term (nK(1+ln 2pi) vs ||Z_hat||^2), volume term ln|H| (absent in C_Q) and the K-invariant penalty offset; no single term is named as THE cause
C_Lap selecting K_TRUE more often does not show that the C_Q prior term is the only cause of under-selection, nor that C_Lap is correct or consistent
C_Lap and C_Q agreeing on K~5 in A-b-9 is reported as consistent with limited information under this theta_hat, not as proof
theta_hat is the MCEM estimate (Q-based), not the maximiser of ln p_Lap
INCOMPLETE datasets are never imputed; selection counts keep denominator 10
exploratory: no confirmatory claim, no threshold chosen after the run
